subject: MAP: Commitment and GPU lead-time warranty + contingency plan
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@vantagehealth.com>, Olivia Moreno <olivia.moreno@vantagehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + lead-time warranty proposal (Dedicated/Private)

Hi Samir / Olivia —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is a first-pass MAP and a short capacity workbook so your procurement and infra teams can see how we landed on the tranche sizes. High-level proposal:

- MAP milestones: evaluation window (2 weeks), canary/acceptance (3 weeks), final go-live (target: within 8–12 weeks after signature for Dedicated H100 pools).
- GPU sizing (proposed up-front): 48 H100-equivalent vCPU allocation split into tranches (20 / 14 / 14) to match your phase 1–3 traffic ramp. See capacity-math.xlsx for token-level cost modelling.
- Private on-prem option: lead-time is longer (typically 14–20 weeks) depending on your hardware supplier and racks — we can include a staged handoff plan in the MAP if you choose on-prem.
- Acceptance criteria: throughput targets, p99 latency for 512-token requests, and a quality gate (eval set pass-rate >= 92%).

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.docx, capacity-math.xlsx, SOC2-summary.pdf.

Can you confirm procurement windows (internal PO review times) and whether you want the final MAP to include an explicit procurement fallback (burst + hosted fallback) in case hardware delivery slips? If procurement prefers, we can offer a short-term hosted-burst warranty for the first 6 weeks after signature at a fixed per-token uplift.

I’ll loop in Karthik and Marissa for the exact lead-time warranty language and price impact.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

From: Samir Patel <samir@vantagehealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Olivia Moreno <olivia.moreno@vantagehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@vantagehealth.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + lead-time warranty proposal (Dedicated/Private)

Naomi —

Thanks for the plan and the workbook. A few clarifying Qs from our side before we share this with procurement:

1) The tranche split looks reasonable, but can you show the minimum viable tranche for phase 1 (if we need to reduce spend during evaluation)? What does the product look like at 12 H100-equivalent?
2) For the hosted-burst warranty you mentioned, what is the explicit SLA and the cost uplift? We need a firm fallback in the MAP if the Dedicated delivery slips past week 12.
3) Procurement asked for SOC2 artifacts and a short statement on data residency for logs during the staged rollout — we have them on cc.

If you can send a one-page procurement summary with the timeline options (8w / 12w / 20w) and the cost delta for the hosted fallback, we can move this to our internal finance + procurement review today.

Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Product, VantageHealth
samir@vantagehealth.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@vantagehealth.com>, Olivia Moreno <olivia.moreno@vantagehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + lead-time warranty proposal (Dedicated/Private)

Samir —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Short answers inline, and I attached a 1-page procurement summary (also saved to the MAP doc link):

1) Minimum viable tranche: 12 H100-equivalent. At that size we recommend the following conservative knobs: 8-token request cache, 32 concurrent streams, and strict prefix caching for embeddings-heavy traffic. The capacity workbook includes expected p99 numbers at 12/20/48 tranche sizes.

2) Hosted-burst warranty: 6-week burst capacity guaranteed to match the committed tranche size within 48 hours of a delivery exception, capped at a 20% token-cost uplift from standard hosted pricing. SLA: availability target 99.5% for the burst pool during warranty period; fallback routing to regionally available hosted clusters. We can codify a credit policy if outage > 1 hour during the warranty window.

3) SOC2 & data residency: attaching SOC2-summary.pdf. Logs during the staged rollout are stored in-region (US-East) for Hosted and in your VPC for Private; we can add a clause for log-retention length per your compliance reqs.

I also included a short table of price deltas for the 8/12/20-week procurement scenarios in capacity-math.xlsx — bottom-line impacts and an optional early-bird credit if you sign within 7 days of this MAP.

If procurement confirms they can complete PO within 10 business days, the 8–12 week delivery cadence is achievable for Dedicated pools. If procurement needs 3–4 weeks, we should plan for the hosted-burst warranty to bridge the gap.

Next steps: please confirm preferred tranche size for phase 1 and whether procurement wants the hosted fallback verbatim in the MAP. Happy to turn this into a redline-ready MAP doc for signature.

Best,
Naomi

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP + lead-time warranty proposal (internal redline request)

Karthik / Marissa —

Forwarding Samir's procurement Qs and my responses. Quick asks before I send the redline-ready MAP:

- Can we firm up the hosted-burst uplift at 20% or should we hold a band (15–25%)? Procurement prefers deterministic numbers.
- For the 48 H100 tranche, what is the earliest ship date we can guarantee if PO is received within 10 business days? I want a concrete week number for the MAP (not a range) if possible.
- Any input on credit terms for >1 hour outage during warranty window? They asked for credit language.

Notes: include SOC2-summary.pdf as evidence; I will not share kernel-level benchmarks in the MAP so we keep those for technical handoff.

From: Samir Patel <samir@vantagehealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olivia Moreno <olivia.moreno@vantagehealth.com>, procurement@vantagehealth.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + lead-time warranty proposal (Dedicated/Private)

Naomi / Karthik —

This looks good. Procurement is comfortable with the 20% hosted-burst uplift so long as the warranty language includes the 48-hour activation SLA and the credit clause for availability < 99.5% (we're okay with the proposed >1 hour credit on a per-hour prorated basis).

We want to proceed with a phase-1 tranche of 20 H100-equivalent (not the minimum 12). Please include the following in the redline MAP:

- Explicit clause: if Dedicated delivery misses the contractual ship date by >10 business days, Redwood will deliver the committed tranche in hosted-burst capacity within 48 hours at the 20% uplift.
- Acceptance date target: final signature by 2027-07-15; go-live target (Dedicated) 2027-09-09 (this assumes PO + ARO timelines described above).

If you can send a redline today with those two items, I will route for signature on our side.

Samir
notes: Procurement asked for a one-page summary and SOC2 artifact; internal team to finalize warranty wording and firm ship weeks. External accepted 20 H100 tranche and 20% hosted uplift; target signature 2027-07-15.
